benchmark_title: Rippl Quantitative Invalidation Benchmark (FalkorDB vs Recursive SQL vs Flat Vector RAG)
evaluation_scope: All 30 claims evaluated against ground-truth causal sets authored in seed_pep.py

recursive_sql.name: Recursive SQL CTE (SQLite 3)
recursive_sql.architectural_note: Most of the 0.85ms gap between FalkorDB and SQLite is client-server network socket overhead. On 113 nodes, both execute in sub-millisecond time. The key distinction is query expressiveness: 1 concise Cypher line vs. 15 lines of recursive SQL self-joins.

vector_rag.name: Flat-Vector RAG (Cosine Top-5)
vector_rag.embedded_content: Node text descriptions (claim statements, decision policies, action descriptions).

baseline_footnote: Evaluated across all 30 claims in the 113-node causal graph. Ground truth blast radius is computed from the causal edges authored in seed_pep.py. Both FalkorDB and SQLite CTE achieve 100.0% recall in sub-millisecond execution. Most of the 0.85ms latency gap reflects client-server network socket overhead of FalkorDB compared to in-process execution of SQLite. Flat-Vector RAG uses real BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings of node text, achieving 45.4% macro-average recall because downstream operational policies and execution actions share zero lexical or semantic similarity with low-level database metrics.
